message.content: Design a PHP implementation plan for adding a `render_uploaded_image()` helper to a custom MVC PHP 7.4 project. This helper will output `` markup with webp-first fallback whenever an uploaded image is rendered. ## Background The project already has: - `src/Core/ImageProcessor::makeWebpSibling($absolutePath)` — on upload, creates `.webp` sibling alongside original (jpg/jpeg/png/gif → .webp). SVG/ICO are skipped. - `imageUpload()` in `inc/lib/func.php:214` — already calls `makeWebpSibling()` automatically - `imageDelete()` in `inc/lib/func.php:271` — already calls `deleteWebpSibling()` automatically - Upload path registry: disk paths via `UPLOAD_DIR_*`, web URL paths via `UPLOAD_WDIR_*` globals - Project root known via `$NO_PROJECT_ROOT` global / `NO_PROJECT_ROOT` constant ## Existing image rendering (all plain ``, no `` anywhere): 1. `views/pages/index.php:459` — `` (portfolio grid) 2. `views/pages/works/view.php:124` — `` (hero) 3. `views/pages/works/view.php:144` — `` (detail images loop) 4. `views/components/work-modal.php:103` — `` (modal hero) 5. `views/components/work-modal.php:121` — `` (modal detail loop) 6. `views/pages/inside/insight.php:58` — `` (board list) 7. `views/pages/inside/insight-view.php:42` — `` (board detail) Award icons in views/pages/inside/award.php and views/pages/about/index.php → SKIP (small decorative icons). ## Helper function design requirements Function signature: `render_uploaded_image(string $src, string $alt, string $class = '', string $loading = ''): string` Logic: - If $src is empty → return `''` - If $src ends in .svg or .ico → plain `` (no webp conversion) - Otherwise (jpg/jpeg/png/gif) → output `` with `` + `` - Derive webp URL by replacing extension: `/uploads/works/abc.jpg` → `/uploads/works/abc.webp` - Do NOT do disk-existence checks at render time (avoid file I/O per request; trust that makeWebpSibling ran at upload time; browser silently falls back to `` if .webp missing) - All attributes must be HTML-escaped (use `htmlspecialchars`) - `loading` attr should be included in `` only if non-empty ## Where to add the helper Option A: Append to `inc/lib/func.php` Option B: Append to `config/functions.php` Recommend the better option considering the project's existing patterns (func.php has imageUpload/imageDelete, functions.php has base_path/e() etc.) ## Backfill script Design a standalone PHP CLI script (e.g., `scripts/backfill-webp.php`) that: - Iterates over all files in `uploads/` recursively - For each jpg/jpeg/png/gif found, calls `ImageProcessor::makeWebpSibling()` - Reports count of created / skipped / failed ## Views update List exact before/after changes for each of the 7 view locations above. ## Constraints - PHP 7.4, no Laravel/Symfony - Custom MVC, no framework helpers - `e()` function exists for HTML escaping - No new files in views/ for this (inline helper call is fine) - All existing `class`, `alt`, `loading` attributes must be preserved Produce a concrete step-by-step implementation plan with file paths and before/after code snippets.
